seriesTitle: My Life with the Walter Boys

episodes.title: Welcome to Colorado
episodes.summary: After a tragic loss, Jackie moves in with the Walters and tries to adjust to small-town life. But a new home and new high school bring new challenges.

episodes.title: Live a Little
episodes.summary: When the brothers make a bet involving a prank on Jackie, she turns to Katherine but learns that the boys have their own way of handling their issues.

episodes.title: The Cole Effect
episodes.summary: At the Homecoming Huddle, Alex and Jackie run the Walter family cider cart together with help from Cole, who struggles to accept life without football.

episodes.title: Nineteen
episodes.summary: On Lucy's birthday, Jackie decides to skip school and attend a lake house party with Cole, where the two play a high-stakes version of Truth or Dare.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Jackie wants to avoid the first Thanksgiving without her family, but a surprise visitor lifts her mood and presents her with a difficult choice.

episodes.title: Baggage
episodes.summary: Before the big bonfire, Jackie learns about Cole and Alex's history with another girl. At the party, relationships new and old go up in flames.

episodes.title: Small Town Rumors
episodes.summary: As rumors fly about the Walter boys, Alex and Cole's sibling rivalry reaches its breaking point. Later, the family deals with an unsettling emergency.

episodes.title: Spinning Out
episodes.summary: When Katherine wins an award for her veterinarian work, the family jumps to support her — except Cole, who instead heads down a path of self-destruction.

episodes.title: Revolutions
episodes.summary: Jackie misses Alex's county fair rodeo for an important interview and tries to keep her distance from Cole after their hurtful exchange.

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: With the Walter boys' help, Jackie diligently plans a picture-perfect ranch wedding. But no amount of checklists can prepare her for what happens next.

episodes.title: Start Fresh
episodes.summary: Back from New York City, Jackie learns that picking up where she left off with the Walters won't be easy — especially with Alex and Cole.

episodes.title: My Life Without the Walter Boys
episodes.summary: Jackie channels her energy into keeping a tradition alive. Katherine and George are forced to loosen their reins — whether they want to or not.

episodes.title: Girls Just Wanna have Fundraisers
episodes.summary: In his new role, Cole struggles to separate leadership from friendship. Jackie and George discover that letting go of the past is harder than expected.

episodes.title: No-look Pass
episodes.summary: An impulsive brag sends Jackie and Grace on a club-hopping quest. The gridiron heats up as the Big Horns seek redemption against their archrivals.

episodes.title: A Night to Remember
episodes.summary: Paris comes to Silver Falls High at an enchanting fall formal. But not everyone will leave the dance with their dignity intact.

episodes.title: After the Dance
episodes.summary: After an incident at the ranch, the Walters reassess what's most important to them. Jackie delivers an emotional message to the junior class.

episodes.title: Saddle Up
episodes.summary: With no room for distraction, Alex kicks up dust to achieve his dream. Determined to start anew, Cole faces an uphill climb.

episodes.title: Gear Shifts
episodes.summary: A college fair sparks tension — and opportunity — at Silver Falls High. As horns lock over the ranch's future, Will gets caught in the middle.

episodes.title: Allhallowtide
episodes.summary: Couple trouble brews beneath the surface at Skylar's Halloween spooktacular, while a reminder of loss reawakens Jackie's bittersweet feelings.

episodes.title: Showdowns and Sparkles
episodes.summary: Jackie, Cole and Alex face tests of focus and courage in the runup to Silver Falls' annual festival. But it's their hearts that will be tested most.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: In the wake of a medical emergency, Jackie and Katherine fight to keep the fractured Walters together as they reassess their lives and what matters most.

episodes.title: Split Focus
episodes.summary: Jackie struggles to keep up with school commitments as Cole hits a roadblock at the garage. Alex's fame opens the door to an exclusive event.

episodes.title: Fever Pitch
episodes.summary: A high-octane hobby sparks friction at home. While George hits a recovery milestone, Jackie scouts the perfect location for a project close to her heart.

episodes.title: Screeching Tires and True Love
episodes.summary: An unexpected visitor arrives for Jackie, sparking a mixed reaction from Cole. Kiley's well-intentioned gesture pushes Alex toward a rowdy crowd.

episodes.title: The Jackie and Cole Effect
episodes.summary: Cole discovers a bargain in a barn. A surprise reunion at the ranch reopens old wounds. Jackie throws a party for Grace that takes an eventful turn.

episodes.title: Wide Open Spaces
episodes.summary: With the rumor mill in full swing, tensions flare between Richard and Jackie over her future. Danny and Erin feel the strain of their shared secret.

episodes.title: Washout
episodes.summary: A troubling exchange with Wylder leaves Alex on edge. An awkward family dinner forces Kiley to face uncomfortable questions about her home life.

episodes.title: Everybody’s Fine
episodes.summary: Jackie's feverish attempt to regain control pushes her to the brink. Katherine urges Alex to join Cole on a treacherous climb.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: While renovating the teen annex, Jackie and her crew uncover a haunting secret frozen in time. George's absence looms over the family scavenger hunt.

episodes.title: The Beautiful and the Damned
episodes.summary: As a daunting setback threatens the opening of the community space, Jackie, Cole and Alex reconsider their futures — both romantically and beyond.
